title: Company
description: One listed company: identity, classification, market cap, profile and logo. Unknown values are null, never guessed.

ticker.description: Ticker as used in the logo file name

market.description: Upper-case market key, for example IN, US, KOREA

currency.description: Price currency; minor units such as GBX can differ from marketCap.currency

usd.description: Approximate: converted at the daily rate in fx-rates.json

listingDate.description: First listing on an exchange, not the founding date

confidence.description: low = community data that may be out of date (Wikidata); medium = exchange, registry or curated data

since.description: Start of the term when the source records it; null = unknown, so verify before use

confidence.description: low = community data that may be out of date (Wikidata); medium = exchange, registry or curated data

since.description: Start of the term when the source records it; null = unknown, so verify before use

svg.description: Vector logo; null for the few older companies that only have a PNG (use `file`)

file.description: The logo file in the logos/ folder, always present

png.description: PNG URLs by pixel size (64, 128, 256, 512); present for the 3,000 largest companies

brandColor.description: Taken from the logo file: an approximation, not an official brand colour

isPlaceholder.description: true = generated initials badge, not a real logo

secondaryListing.description: true = a copy of a company whose main listing is elsewhere (depositary receipt, CEDEAR, BDR, cross-listing); it ranks below main listings

aliasOf.description: Set on an exchange spelling or former ticker (M&M, ZOMATO): the ticker whose company file and logo this one repeats

sources.description: Where each profile value came from

checks.description: A second source that disagreed with a value we hold
